sellingPoints: Trendy sloping roof with acrylic glass skylight and roof overhang
Double the sheet steel thickness compared to low-cost providers
Maintenance-free for life: 20-year guarantee subject to Biohort's warranty terms and conditions.

ECO* Version: at an Attractive Price - corrugated door and T-handle cylinder lock, integrated organiser system on the inside of the door and door hooks instead of the gas spring; the ECO* version does not include any standard equipment.

Functionality: Integrated gutter with a connection for 1 1/4" hose
Acrylic glass skylight with roof overhang
Security: 3-way locking mechanism complete with stainless steel door handle / 2-way locking mechanism in the ECO Version
Robust roof construction for a snow load of up to 150 kg/m²
Storm-proof up to wind force 12 (according to the Beaufort scale: hurricane) with professional assembly and anchoring
Quality at its best: Top quality materials: galvanised, polyamide enamel coated steel plate, screws and hinges made of stainless steel
20-year guarantee subject to Biohort's warranty terms and conditions.
Extensive range of standard equipment (not included in the ECO* version)

AvantGarde: Shelves / support rails: two shelves (length 24.5 cm, width 72 cm) and two support rails; galvanised; max. load 15 kg per shelf
Tool holders: two on the inside of the door (max. five per door panel)
Gas spring: assists opening and closing, holds the door open or closed
AvantGarde ECO*: The Standard Equipment is not included in the ECO version (page). ECO has corrugated door, T-handle cylinder lock, 2-way locking, integrated organiser system on the inside of the door and door hooks instead of the gas spring.

guarantee: 20-year guarantee subject to Biohort's warranty terms and conditions (FAQ: corrosion of metal parts and defective/unusable parts; 24-month statutory warranty for wear, moving, electrical, plastic and rubber parts).
delivery: Free Shipping within 3 weeks (product page and every variant's delivery_message).
packaging: Packed in 5 to 8 cartons, easily understandable assembly manual included.
steelThickness: No figure published. "Double the sheet steel thickness compared to low-cost providers"; galvanised with protective zinc layer of at least 150 g/m² and polyamide enamel coating.
roof: Modern sloping (pent) roof with front acrylic glass skylight and roof overhang; snow load 150 kg/m²; wind 150 km/h | wind force 12 with professional assembly and anchoring.

pageBundles: The product page offers per-size packages "Basic", "Premium", "Care" and "Side canopy". For ECO* variants (both door options) the Basic package is only support rails 46021, shelves 45010 and tool hangers 47020 (the classic model's standard equipment), and the Premium package swaps in the Neo/Eco tool holder 47032/47052/47082.
